paragraph: Tenafly is a single-family town, with 68 detached sales over six months against 8 condo and townhouse closings. The single-family median sits at $1,700,000, the sale-to-list ratio is essentially even at 1.0003, half of homes sold above asking, and the median days on market is 18. That is competitive but not frenzied. Well-priced homes move in under three weeks, and sellers are getting their number without buyers bidding wildly past it. The range runs from $555,000 to $6,650,000, so the median is the better guide than the average here. On the monthly series, June was the peak with 19 sales at a $2,400,000 median, and July held volume at 18 while the median came back to $1,662,500. That is a mix shift toward the middle of the market, not a price drop, and it tracks the normal Bergen arc where early summer carries the biggest houses. If the usual pattern holds, expect volume to thin through fall. The condo and townhouse tier is too small at 8 sales to read as a trend, but it clusters around $698,500 and gives you a low-maintenance option in a town otherwise built on space and grounds.
